panels.description:
Free disk space available to CockroachDB data.

[How is this metric calculated?](https://www.cockroachlabs.com/docs/v21.1/ui-storage-dashboard.html#capacity-metrics)

targets.expr: (avg by (cluster) (rebalancing_cpunanospersecond{job="cockroachdb",cluster=~"$cluster"}) - 50000000) <= (avg by (cluster) (rebalancing_cpunanospersecond{job="cockroachdb",cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0.9) or ((avg by (cluster) (rebalancing_cpunanospersecond{job="cockroachdb",cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0.9 < avg by (cluster) (rebalancing_cpunanospersecond{job="cockroachdb",cluster=~"$cluster"}) - 50000000))
